parties.petitioner: Jai Narain Vyas University, Jodhpur and Anr.

summary: The University challenged the High Court's decision to regularize the services of employees appointed on contractual basis after 15-30 years of service, citing parity with six employees regularized in 1999. The Supreme Court upheld regularization but limited actual consequential benefits to three years prior to filing of writ petitions, while granting notional continuity from the date of regularization of similarly placed employees to balance institutional financial burden and employees' rights.
final_judgment: Appeals partly allowed; regularization upheld with notional continuity from date of similarly placed employees' regularization, but actual consequential benefits restricted to three years prior to filing of writ petitions; no order as to costs.
